motto: Volunteers Dedicated to Saving Lives in New Brunswick
coverageArea: Fredericton, York and Sunbury Counties, and across New Brunswick

emergencyNotice.title: EMERGENCY: DIAL 911
emergencyNotice.message: If someone is missing or in distress, please dial 911 immediately. Police agencies activate volunteer Search & Rescue teams. There is no waiting period to report a missing person.

banner.text: New Member recruitment is open! Join our team as an operational searcher or non-operational volunteer.
